768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.headline: They took the map. We took the loss.
768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.team: The enemy took every Fangtooth and Prime objective recorded, then dismantled our structures. Our winning skirmishes produced no quick objective return. We could win exchanges, but the enemy kept winning the map.

focus.title: Give the next fight a purpose
focus.action: Before the next objective contest, name the target, the player covering the approach, and the retreat condition. Check afterward whether those assignments happened, not just whether the team got kills.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Wukong brought strong damage and cleared enemy wards with sentry. Keep that denial. Before sweeping for a gank, call the target lane and confirm the laner can follow; before an objective, call the setup and whether the team is contesting or trading. Give the team a plan to respond to, not a fucking guessing game.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Revenant kept the farm and deaths under control, but hero damage fell below his usual output on the hero. A tidy score does not finish the carry job. Keep the discipline; in the next safe firing window, focus on landing the remaining shots before reloading, then reposition instead of forcing a dangerous finish.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett placed plenty of wards and kept deaths low, but recorded no objective damage. Before returning to lane near the next contest, cover a safe objective approach if a ward is available, then prepare the wave so a rotation costs less. Give the team a usable route; chasing a higher ward total is not the assignment.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gideon had the team's most deaths, including one before the late structure losses. For the next contest, hold the escape until the threat is accounted for and agree on a retreat call with Steel before committing. Keep contributing damage, but do not let owning the recommended core become a fucking permission slip to overcommit.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel led mitigation and assists. Keep enabling the team. When the next gank or objective call comes, confirm whether Steel is engaging or holding control to peel, and coordinate the follow-up. Tainted Guard applies healing reduction to an enemy that basic-attacks its wearer; owning it does not mean every enemy being healed is covered.

25.call: Gideon died to Crunch. Two Inner Towers and an Inhibitor fell afterward; event timing alone does not establish that the death caused those losses.

31.call: The final kill sequence ended 1-2 immediately before the Core fell. Kill credits do not establish who was present.

10.7.call: Enemy Fangtooth was taken before the kill sequence began; the subsequent sequence ended 1-4.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Jungle matchup: Yin, with ganks into Gadget, Crunch, and Murdock plus Mourn. This is not a fixed solo lane. Crunch and Mourn finished with armor items, so the target of each gank matters more than whether the build matches a popular list.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: The Perforator gives percentage armor penetration, and Deathstalker adds armor shred through repeated basic attacks on heroes. That combination has a purpose against the armored front line. Deathstalker needs repeated contact; do not assume its full stacked value in a brief gank or assign clone interactions without verification.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Lotus supplies random scaling bonuses rather than a guaranteed defensive response. Early Bloom rewards reaching its level breakpoint; Immaculate protects only while health stays high. Against a setup that chips health before the commit, that protection may be gone before the dive. Keep it for healthy entries, not as a substitute for sustained durability.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Masterful Mimicry adds clone capacity and generates Hair over time. It supports the clone plan, but the match record cannot show clone uptime or how often that extra capacity mattered. There is no basis here to declare another augment a proven upgrade.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Nex stores recent hero damage for its dash burst, so its value depends on the damage window and follow-up target. It fits finishing a gank; it is not a generic defensive answer when committing into several enemies.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: Keep the armor-answering tools when Crunch or Mourn is the reachable target. If those targets cannot be attacked safely long enough to stack Deathstalker, compare a survival slot against it before adding more damage. Decide from the actual threat ending the entry, not simply the count of physical heroes.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Duo lane was Revenant with Steel into Murdock with Mourn. Later fights also included Crunch, whose final inventory added armor and sustain. Mourn finished with Warden's Faith, a direct reduction to critical-strike damage; that gives a concrete reason to inspect target selection and armor answers.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Demolisher addresses physical armor, including additional bonus-armor penetration for attacks and critical strikes. That is relevant into Crunch and Mourn. It does not erase Warden's Faith's separate critical-damage reduction. Terminus supports lifesteal and an overheal shield, but cannot provide that shield without excess healing first.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Vermis needs consecutive attacks on the same hero within its time window. Serration adds missing-health damage to its proc, while Melting Point rewards hitting targets above its armor threshold. Those choices have a plausible front-line purpose; target switches or reload gaps can limit the sequence. Actual proc counts and armor thresholds during fights are not recorded.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Hellfire Blast strengthens the fourth shot and ignores some bonus physical armor on that shot. It fits this armored enemy inventory and reinforces the safe shot-completion takeaway. It does not establish that fourth shots were missed, nor should its armor penetration simply be added to Demolisher as one combined percentage.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Pacifier offers a dash and an empowered physical-damage instance, with extra payoff against low-health targets. Use its movement to preserve a safe firing opportunity as well as to finish. A reset opportunity is not a reason to chase through the enemy team.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: Keep Demolisher in the armor-focused plan. If Mourn's healing or enemy sustain remains the problem on the hero Revenant can safely hit, compare Tainted Rounds for direct anti-heal application, trading a damage or sustain slot rather than blindly replacing the armor answer. Coordinate that purchase with Steel or Gideon; ownership alone does not guarantee coverage.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.matchup: Offlane opponent: Crunch. His final build included Mutilator, Salvation, Draconum and armor, which makes sustained trades and healing reduction relevant. Gadget remained a separate magic-damage threat in team fights; physical armor alone does not answer the full lineup.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Mutilator supplies target-max-health damage through attacks and qualifying ability hits. Tainted Guard brings physical armor and reduces healing on enemies that basic-attack Scarlett, giving it a clear purpose against a trading Crunch. Terminus adds sustain, but the final three-item inventory cannot establish when any of these tools came online.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Knell shreds both armors through repeated hero hits and grants armor from that shred. Peal helps apply maximum Rust stacks after the ultimate; Patina rewards damage-free time with a shield. This favors a prepared entry into an extended exchange. Patina is less dependable during constant chip damage, and the record does not show its shield uptime.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.augment: Volcaic Slam adds a delayed eruption and slow to Empowered Cindara. It offers follow-up pressure if Crunch remains in the eruption area. Its delayed hit is a condition, not guaranteed damage; a movement-heavy exchange may change its value.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.crest: Liberator provides a cleanse and short shield, a defensive purpose that can matter when control prevents an exit or follow-up. The record does not identify which debuffs were cleansed or whether the active was available at a death.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.improvement: The existing Knell and anti-heal plan fits the Crunch matchup. If repeated immobilization is the real obstacle, compare Resonant Repair against Peal at draft time: defensive recovery and tenacity versus faster Rust application after the ultimate. Do not replace the whole build just because objective damage was low.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Mid opponent: Gadget. Her final build included Soulbinder for long-range ability pressure, Megacosm for health-based damage and Entropy for additional ability-hit damage. Crunch's later armor and health items also change the targets available in team fights; lane and late-fight needs are different.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Azure Core stacks mana and grants mana-scaling power when those stacks are complete, alongside a low-health shield; Combustion adds ability-hit burst, while Wraith Leggings rewards damage into low-health heroes. That is an offensive package, not a dedicated answer to Gadget's pressure. The final inventory does not tell us Azure Core stacks or whether its shield was ready when Gideon died.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh extends ability damage with a DoT. Tithe of Death rewards takedowns with mana and haste; Phylactery adds post-ultimate cooldown progression and a mana-based shield. That works with a mana investment, but the protection has a trigger and window. It does not prove the ultimate was safe to commit or completed.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Event Horizon adds target-max-health damage to center hits of Cosmic Rift. Crunch and Mourn's health investments give that effect a matchup purpose. Landing the center is essential; the feed cannot score those hits or prove another augment would have performed better.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Soulbearer adds a mana-scaling shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed during its active window. It complements the mana package and offers a planned defensive window, but it does not make enemy control irrelevant or prove correct active use.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: If the team cannot keep healing reduction on a reachable target, compare Tainted Scepter against a damage slot such as Wraith Leggings: direct magical-damage application versus low-health finishing damage. If Gadget's pressure is instead preventing contribution, prioritize a defensive comparison. The death count alone cannot decide which problem caused the loss.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.matchup: Support lane was Steel with Revenant into Murdock with Mourn. Crunch and Yin added later physical threats, while Gadget supplied substantial ability pressure. Build decisions should distinguish protecting Revenant from surviving an engage, rather than treating every tank item as interchangeable.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Xenia shields nearby allies, so its support value depends on proximity. Dynamo creates a short damage-amplification window after immobilizing an enemy, rewarding coordinated follow-up. Stonewall and Tainted Guard favor physical durability; Tainted Guard only applies anti-heal to enemies that basic-attack Steel, not automatically to everyone Mourn heals.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Krix increases maximum health, which also supports the health scaling on Xenia and Sanctification. Cannibalism rewards takedowns with more health. Regenerative Tissue favors recovery outside hero damage; Festering Wounds is a meaningful draft alternative when Steel needs to apply anti-heal through immobilizing effects instead of waiting to be attacked.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.augment: Heavy Metal adds damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor. The armor purchases therefore have an offensive interaction as well as a defensive one. That synergy does not prove the hits landed or justify ignoring Gadget's damage type.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.crest: Sanctification shields Steel and nearby allies, granting tenacity while the shield holds. It supports a planned group commitment or peel. Neither the final inventory nor mitigation totals show whether allies were in range or the active was used at the useful moment.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.improvement: At draft time, compare Festering Wounds with Regenerative Tissue if reliable healing reduction is Steel's job. During the match, if Gadget is the threat forcing Steel out, compare magical defense before another physical-only purchase. Preserve Dynamo's follow-up plan and Xenia proximity; do not assume two Tainted Guards guarantee coverage on the team's chosen target.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.note: The user confirmed Wukong ran sentry in this losing match.

768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.lossReflection: The stronger alternative was to set up before the next objective. Send the nearby laner to prepare the wave and cover a safe approach, have Wukong communicate the gank or objective plan before sweeping, and confirm who can follow. If the approach is unsafe, call a reachable trade or defend together. Winning a skirmish is not a fucking shopping receipt for an objective; someone still has to call what is safely available.
